name: ShellGPT
official_status_notes: MIT-licensed command-line productivity tool: generates shell commands, code snippets, and documentation from LLMs; works with an OpenAI API key or a local Ollama backend; PowerShell/CMD/Bash/Zsh; REPL and chat modes (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free, open source; OpenAI API costs if you use cloud models.
best_for: Quick shell-command and code generation in any shell without a full coding agent.
strengths: Lightweight; Ollama support; shell-command generation with explanations.
weaknesses: Not a repo-editing agent; API costs when using cloud models.
hardware_requirements: Tiny CLI; heavy lifting happens at the model provider.
